description: Search the product knowledge vault by free-text query. Useful when you need product knowledge but don't yet know which concept ids exist. Returns ranked hits (id, title, type, score, snippet) only; get_concept returns one full note and get_context an assembled briefing. An empty hit list means nothing matched.

mode.description: Search mode. "hybrid" (default) fuses keyword and semantic ranking; semantic silently falls back to keyword if embeddings are unavailable.

product.description: Only return concepts belonging to this product.

query.description: Free-text search query, e.g. "lead scoring" or "session auth".

tags.description: Only return concepts carrying ALL of these tags.

type.description: Only return concepts of this type.

name: search_concepts
title: Search concepts
